title: FlowRunner: a `FLOW_FAILED` envelope is rendered by the record-save rule — the author's `errorMessage`, then `userMessage`, then the declared inner refusal, then `message` (the console half of objectstack#24914 ruling B′)
body:
Filing gate ③ — the objectui half of ruling **B′** on objectstack-ai/objectstack#24914 (the maintainer's 「同意」 in the director's chat, 2026-10-20), filed by the director seat (summon objectstack-ai/objectui#45 continuation 2, `session_01Lg6GQ4xjqmvEzYv78d6H7i`) under ruling D on objectstack-ai/objectstack#24591: a card that straddles repositories is split by repository. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** the objectui `domain:ui` seat, once the `@objectstack/spec` release that declares the member (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24996) is installable here and the doors emit it (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24914). Until then this card is `pm:blocked`.

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#24996
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#24914

**Dedupe:** the 17 open `domain:ui` cards' titles read in this act: 0 name `FLOW_FAILED`, `userMessage` or the flow runner; objectstack#24914's own dedupe across both repositories (25 hits, nearest objectui#12977 closed) stands.

## What the ruling binds for this repository (objectui `origin/main` `53dea27afab5`)

- Today the flow runner prints the `FLOW_FAILED` envelope's `error.message` as the dialog body and the toast (`packages/app-shell/src/utils/flowResponse.ts`, the failure-message rule), after the author's refusing-`end` `errorMessage`; it never reads `userMessage` (0 hits in that file). An engine refusal inside a write node therefore reaches the user as `Node 'create_account' failed: create_record(crm_account) failed: …`, in English under any locale (measured on HotCRM, objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2073 item 8).
- After the spec release: the `FLOW_FAILED` arm reads, in order, the author's `errorMessage`, the envelope's top-level `userMessage`, the declared inner refusal member (rendered by the rule the record form already has at `packages/components/src/form/form.tsx:3023-3026`: `userMessage`, then the permission substitution, then the inner message with its prefix stripped), then `message`. The developer console keeps the raw `message`.
- Nothing else moves: no regex over `message`, no new copy per code, no change to the refusing-`end` path (objectstack-ai/objectstack#15788) or to the FlowRunner's layout. The inner code's wire spelling is `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` for a unique refusal (the record-save rule already branches on the data door's wire codes).

## What done looks like

- A unique refusal shows the inner sentence without the `Node '…' failed: create_record(…) failed:` wrapper; a validation refusal shows the author's rule text; a permission refusal shows the localised substitute; a hook refusal shows its marked `userMessage`; an envelope without the member falls back to `message` (never to silence).
- Pinned in the app-shell tests on a real `FLOW_FAILED` envelope fixture; ablation red.

objectstack-ai/objectstack#24914 (the ruled card) · objectstack-ai/objectstack#24996 (the spec half) · objectstack-ai/objectui#5210 (`userMessage` rendering ruling) · objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2073 item 8 (measurement).
